record_convention: A JSON object is one record; a top-level JSON array counts its elements; JSONL counts its nonempty lines.
count_convention: root_boxes counts objects with array-valued center and R; arcs and leaves count the elements of array-valued fields with those names. Scalar summary fields are not counted again.
